Until the end of the encounter, the manticore has a double edge on power rolls against [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) creatures. Additionally, any creature [weakened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/weakened) by the manticore's Tail Spike ability has their speed halved and takes an extra 3 poison damage at the start of each of their turns.
